title: The Roar

voice_map.BRAMBLE: Grimblewood Thornwhisker - Snarky Gnome & Magical Maintainer (ouL9IsyrSnUkCmfnD02u), 3x credit rate
voice_map.SCUTTLE: Ziggy - Cute little Aussie character (J1lfByWs8gvoooryDWEi), pitch-shifted +2 semitones + 12% faster tempo

notes: Per-line dialogue/timing manifest for Act 3. Voice is ElevenLabs TTS (eleven_multilingual_v2), generated on a paid Creator-tier account -- commercial use permitted, still requires ElevenLabs attribution per their ToS (see AUDIO_CREDITS.md/README.md). Pip, Bramble, Old Bottlecap, and Scuttle reuse the exact voice IDs and post-processing established in Act 1 (see Act 1's own ACT_01_DIALOGUE.json / README.md for that A/B-testing history) -- no re-casting, just the same voices reading new lines. Grommet (Jasper) and Chairman Toggle (Posh Josh) are new voice casts, picked via a 3-candidate A/B test each, first voiced in this act.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 0, Cold open, Pip asks Grommet given the tremor
lines.text: I know you wanted your minute. I don't think we get one. That tremor wasn't nothing.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 0, Grommet conflicted
lines.text: ...yeah. Yeah, I felt it too. Okay. Okay, this is me deciding something for the first time in a long time.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 0, Grommet opens the Annex, event: annex-opened
lines.text: It's open. Go. I'll be right here — still standing here, just, differently now.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 0, Pip reacts entering
lines.text: Oh. Oh, that's a lot of shiny. That's a genuinely upsetting amount of shiny.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Annex interior / examine general
lines.text: Piles and piles of it. Marbles, mostly. Some buttons that clearly wandered in and regretted it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Annex interior / flavor rotate 1
lines.text: Somebody labeled a whole shelf 'MISC. VERY POPULAR.' That phrase again. It was never a compliment.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Annex interior / flavor rotate 2
lines.text: Years of this. Actual years. Someone's been very busy, in a way nobody was ever supposed to notice.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile hotspot / examine 1st, restates the search criteria as a callback rather than fresh info
lines.text: Somewhere in this pile is the one with the little star-shaped nick — the one Bramble made me describe, back at her desk. Guess I know why she asked now. Okay. Look closely.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 1 examine -- decoy
lines.text: This one's got a whole tiny painted galaxy inside it. Genuinely beautiful. Not the one.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 1 take, fail, returned to pile
lines.text: No nick, no star, just space. Back it goes. Sorry, tiny galaxy.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 2 examine -- decoy
lines.text: This one's got a paper tag: 'Property of the Big One Under the Radiator.' I hope the Big One's doing okay.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 2 take, fail, returned to pile
lines.text: Definitely somebody else's. Also definitely not mentioning the tag to whoever the Big One is.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 3 examine -- the trap decoy, tests attention to the exact clue wording
lines.text: Wait — this one's got a star shape on it too. Hang on, hang on—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 3 take, fail -- close read pays off here
lines.text: ...no. This is a scratch. Mine's a nick — you can feel the edge of it. This one's smooth, just marked. Close, though. Really close.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 4 examine -- decoy
lines.text: This one's suspiciously perfect. Not a mark on it anywhere.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / candidate 4 take, fail, returned to pile
lines.text: Too perfect, actually. Mine's got character. This one's just showing off.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / correct candidate examine
lines.text: ...there. Little nick, lopsided star, right where it's always been. You can feel it, not just see it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 1, Marble Pile / correct candidate take, success, addItem: pips-marble, event: marble-found
lines.text: Hi. I missed you. This is a weird thing to say to a marble.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Chairman Toggle enters the Annex, auto-fire after marble-found
lines.text: I KNEW it. I knew that overgrown doorway would fold the second someone was nice to him. This is exactly the chaos I warned you about!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Pip stands ground
lines.text: It's my marble. I can prove it. You're the one who filed it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Use intake-parcel ALONE on Toggle -- first attempt, deflected, teaches that one document isn't enough
lines.text: It's right here on the label — 'round asset intake' —

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Toggle deflects the parcel alone
lines.text: A shipping label. A LABEL. Has no legal standing on its own, obviously, why would a label alone—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Pip catches the loophole in Toggle's own deflection
lines.text: 'On its own.' Meaning it's not alone that matters. Hang on.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Pip re-examines the parcel, finds the fine print prompted by act03-023
lines.text: There's small print on the back. 'All intake assets must be re-verified with the original claimant, if present.' I'm present. Extremely present.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Use founders-ledger ALONE on Toggle -- second attempt, also deflected
lines.text: And this — recognize the handwriting? 'One button to one button, fair and plain.' Your whole standard.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Toggle deflects the ledger alone
lines.text: A quaint historical document. Sentimental, even. It has no standing over CURRENT procedure, whatever it says—

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Bramble nudges toward the combine without solving it outright
lines.text: ...current procedure that document is the entire foundation of. Pip. Read them together.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Combine founders-ledger + intake-parcel -> item: annotated-evidence, consumes both
lines.text: Together. Right. The parcel's own rule says re-verify with the claimant if present — and the ledger's the only reason the Court's rules mean anything at all. Can't cite one and ignore the other.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 2, Use annotated-evidence on Toggle, success
lines.text: So. Both, together. Your rule, your founder's rule. I'm claiming it. Right now. In person.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Toggle stalls
lines.text: That clause is — that's boilerplate, nobody actually — that's not meant to be USED—

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Toggle deflates
lines.text: ...I didn't PUT him anywhere. He— he stepped back. That's what I was told. That's what everyone was told.

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 2, Toggle concedes, event: toggle-defeated, close, comedic not violent
lines.text: Fine. FINE. Take your— your galaxy marble too, I don't even know whose that is anymore, take the whole shelf, I need to sit down and reconsider several things.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 3, The Roar arrives, environmental cue + reaction
lines.text: ...that's not a tremor. That's the actual — that's the Roar, that's really it, that's really happening right now—

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.context: Sec 3, Bramble urgency
lines.text: Dawn sweep's early, or we lost track of time, or both, it doesn't matter WHY, we need to be anywhere but here—

lines.speaker: CHAIRMAN_TOGGLE
lines.context: Sec 3, Toggle, even now, panics about the hoard first, comedic beat
lines.text: The ASSETS, someone has to think about the— no. No, you're right, forget the assets, THAT'S NEW FOR ME, let's just also please go—

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 3, Grommet steps up, event: grommet-guardian-payoff
lines.text: I've got the doorway. That's — that's actually the one thing I'm built for. Go, I mean it, go!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 3, Pip worried
lines.text: Are you going to be okay?!

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 3, Grommet reassures, close
lines.text: I'm a sock! Air mostly goes around me! GO!

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.context: Sec 4, Scuttle reappears at the escape route
lines.text: There you are! Fastest way out is through the filing booth, trust me, I've timed it, GO GO GO—

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Pip banter mid-run
lines.text: You circled back!

lines.speaker: SCUTTLE
lines.context: Sec 4, Scuttle, close
lines.text: Told you! I always circle back! Just usually for parcels, not — whatever this is!

lines.speaker: OLD_BOTTLECAP
lines.context: Sec 4, Old Bottlecap reopens the Grate, waiting at the exit
lines.text: Figured you'd be back through here in a hurry. Gate's open. My call this time. Nobody asked me to.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 4, Pip responds warmly
lines.text: We found your ledger. The real one. You built this whole place.

lines.speaker: OLD_BOTTLECAP
lines.context: Sec 4, Old Bottlecap, brief vulnerable admission, deadpan not soft
lines.text: Built it fair. Watched it get run different. Didn't have the stomach to fight about it, so I sat down at a gate instead. That's not a proud story. It's just mine.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.context: Sec 4, Bramble, close
lines.text: It's not over, for the record. Somebody's going to run this place honestly. I've got some ideas. We'll talk. After the— the enormous roaring emergency.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 5, Final dash through the Grate, tension peak
lines.text: Go go go go—

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 5, Grommet mid-block, strained but steady, distant/muffled
lines.text: STILL HOLDING! MOSTLY! MOSTLY HOLDING!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 5, Pip checks back once clear, event: roar-passed
lines.text: Grommet! You still— are you—

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 5, Grommet, comedic understatement, close
lines.text: A little windswept. Structurally, emotionally, several other ways. Fine, though! I held it!

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 5, Pip relief beat
lines.text: You held it. Big guy, you actually held it.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.context: Sec 6, Goodbye beat, Bramble reflects
lines.text: I think the Lost and Underfound just got bigger. Properly bigger. The Annex answers to the cubby wall now, not the other way around. I'm going to need a much bigger ledger.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 6, Pip acknowledges her growth
lines.text: You were the one who actually looked. That's the whole job, right? Looking closely.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 6, Grommet, no longer guarding a secret
lines.text: I don't have to stand there not-knowing anymore. That's a strange kind of light feeling. I think I like it.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 6, Pip promises to visit
lines.text: I'll come back down. Not on purpose, probably — I'm not great at staying big — but I'll come back.

lines.speaker: BRAMBLE
lines.context: Sec 6, Bramble farewell
lines.text: You'd better. You're the strangest, fastest-processed claim I've ever handled, and I mean that as a genuine compliment.

lines.speaker: GROMMET
lines.context: Sec 6, Grommet farewell, close of NPC beats
lines.text: Bye, Pip. Thanks for fixing my seam. Thanks for the rest of it too, but mostly the seam.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 7, Transition, Pip shrinks back up, marble in hand
lines.text: Okay. Marble's real, my knees are enormous again, and I have the strangest story I'm never telling a single living soul.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.context: Sec 7, Epilogue, closing line, callback to act01-002 and the talent-show stakes
lines.text: Talent show's in the morning. Lucky charm's back where it belongs. ...Okay. Maybe I tell the talent show judges. A LITTLE of it.
